CyclePond_Text_Hermit.en: Some POKéMON should never evolve.\nThis stone will keep them as they\pare. Take it.
CyclePond_Text_Hermit.fr: Certains POKéMON devraient\njamais évoluer. Cette pierre les\lgarde tels qu'ils sont. Prends-la.

CyclePond_Text_HermitDone.en: Hold it, and nothing changes. That\nis the point.
CyclePond_Text_HermitDone.fr: Fais-la tenir, et rien ne change.\nC'est le but.

CyclePond_Text_Npc0.en: The rarest fish bite when nobody is\nwatching. FEEBAS likes the quiet\pwater.
CyclePond_Text_Npc0.fr: Les poissons les plus rares mordent\nquand personne ne regarde. BARPAU\laime l'eau calme.

CyclePond_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

CyclePond_Text_SpaDone.en: Wonderful! {STR_VAR_1} adores you now.\nEvolutions that need bonds will\pfollow.
CyclePond_Text_SpaDone.fr: Merveilleux ! {STR_VAR_1} t'adore\nmaintenant. Les évolutions qui\lnécessitent un lien suivront.

CyclePond_Text_SpaOffer.en: A bond treatment for 2000 turns a\nPOKéMON into your best friend.\pInterested?
CyclePond_Text_SpaOffer.fr: Un traitement de lien à 2000, ça\nfait de ton POKéMON ton meilleur\lami.\pÇa t'intéresse ?

CyclePond_Text_SpaPoor.en: The treatment costs 2000. Come back\nwith enough.

CyclePond_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
